thread:
maya: Cutting RC from `release/2026-05-15-mux`: rwinf-gateway:v1.5.0-rc1. Key change: multiplexing backpressure fix + quant kernel bump. No DB changes. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/intranet/release/2026-05-15-mux

deploy-bot: [ci] build 4720 succeeded. Artifact pushed: rwinf-gateway:v1.5.0-rc1. Smoke job scheduled (job 11802).

nate: Please pin embed-service and multiplexer-client to the versions we validated: embed-service=1.10.0, multiplexer-client=0.4.1.

maya: Pinfile updated in RC manifest. Also added a compat-check job that runs embed flows.

olivia: Canary plan: start 3% traffic with mux=false for 8m, then flip mux=true on a 3% test group for 10m before ramping. Keeps blast radius small.

pete: Add automatic fallback to v1.4.8 and alert rule: `mux.backpressure_rate > 1% for 5m` -> rollback.

quinn: Noted. Customer X has a 2-hour maintenance window starting 16:00 UTC; schedule full promo after 16:30 UTC.

maya: Acknowledged. Scheduling promo window 16:30-17:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary env created in us-central1. KV prime started. Smoke results: p50=54ms (base 52ms), p95=240ms (base 230ms). No auth or token errors.

olivia: Looks fine. Any tokenization or parse errors? We had regressions last month.

deploy-bot: Tokenize failure rate = 0.01% (baseline 0.01%). Good.

nate: If p95 regresses >12% or tokenize failure >0.2% we abort. Documented in runbook.

maya: Rollback snippet in runbook:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/routing -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS' -d '{"service":"rwinf-gateway","version":"v1.4.8"}'
```
Or `/deploy rollback rwinf-gateway v1.4.8`. Also recommend run `ops/clear-cache` after rollback to avoid stale KV.

pete: Added dashboard tile: `mux.backpressure_rate`, `tokenize_fail_pct`, `kv.cold_start_pct`. Alert set to p95 pager thresholds.

quinn: I'll confirm with Customer X at 16:20 UTC for no-conflict.

deploy-bot: Promotion queued for 16:30 UTC. Post-promo checks: smoke, token-suite, mux-stability.

maya: Please react with :white_check_mark: for final signoff.

nate: :white_check_mark:

olivia: :white_check_mark:

pete: :white_check_mark: (ops)

quinn: :white_check_mark: (cust support)

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Step 1/4: routing shift -> 10% traffic (mux=false).

olivia: Observing logs 1: nothing abnormal.

deploy-bot: Step 2/4: routing shift -> 35% traffic. Metrics nominal.

maya: Flipping mux=true for a 10% test group to validate backpressure fix. Command: `/ops/flag set rwinf-gateway mux true --scope traffic:10`

deploy-bot: Flag flip executed. Test group p95=245ms, mux.backpressure_rate=0.08%. No auth errors.

pete: Keep CPU and reconnects under eye. If mux.backpressure_rate > 0.5% -> immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Step 3/4: routing shift -> 70% traffic. Pausing for 5m observation window.

olivia: Telemetry: tokenize_fail_pct = 0.02%, kv.cold_start_pct = 0.9%. All below thresholds.

deploy-bot: Observation window clear. Final ramp to 100% starting.

deploy-bot: Step 4/4: routing shift -> 100% traffic. Promotion complete. Release notes published: https://internal.redwood/intranet/release/2026-05-15-mux/notes

maya: Great job everyone. Post-promo action: run compatibility sweep for 24h. If no sev reported, we'll close RC ticket.

nate: I'll monitor and escalate if mux.backpressure_rate or tokenize_fail_pct rise.

quinn: Customer X support: no issues reported in first 45m. Thanks team. :party-parrot:
